projects.name: Designed and developed an end-to-end automated competitor intelligence
projects.description:
Designed and developed an end-to-end automated competitor intelligence
platform integrating Multi-Agent AI, RPA, NLP, and MLOps.
Created a workflow where users input queries; the system fetches relevant URLs and extracts top management details using NLP (SpaCy), OCR, and OpenAI APIs.
Integrated logic for generating and validating corporate emails via SMTP checks, and orchestrated UiPath bots to capture LinkedIn profile URLs.
Automated personalized outreach through SMTP + RPA email automation, triggered upon verified contacts.
Orchestrated workflows with CrewAI, LangChain, and FAISS for retrieval, deployed
on AWS for scalability.
Applied full MLOps lifecycle (versioning, monitoring, rollback) for reliability.

Designed and developed AI Chanakya, an end-to-end Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) system that automates data retrieval, classification, and integration into insurance platforms. The system combines UiPath RPA, RAG Pipelines, MLOps lifecycle, NLP (Spacy), and ChatGPT APIs for contextual document understanding. Leveraged LangChain, SQL automation, and chatbot capabilities to validate and process extracted information. The solution significantly reduced processing time while ensuring accuracy and compliance.

AI DHRISHTI – BUSINESS VISION INTELLIGENCE
Problem Statement

Competitor research and lead generation are manual, slow, and error-prone. Analysts spend hours browsing websites, extracting leadership details, validating contacts, and generating business email combinations. Manual outreach limits scalability and delays business development. A fully automated solution was needed to retrieve competitor insights, validate executive contacts, and enable outreach with minimal human effort.
Key Contributions
Reduced competitor research time by 90%.
Improved accuracy in executive data retrieval and validation.
Delivered a production-grade intelligence platform enabling scalable competitor analysis and outreach.
Tech Stack: CrewAI, LangChain, OpenAI API, UiPath, NLP (SpaCy), FAISS, OCR, AWS, MLOps, SMTP Validation, Multi-Agent AI.
